lists.text: Here's how you will make an impact:
lists.content:
• Serve as the primary operations owner for an assigned product line (Refund Transfer, Emerald Card & Spruce, Lending, or Wave), responsible for daytoday execution and change delivery.

  • Partner closely with Product Directors, Operations leaders, and Technology teams to implement new products, enhancements, and operational changes.

  • Translate product requirements into operational execution plans, including workflows, readiness checklists, dependencies, risks, and timelines.

  • Execute and support endtoend product launches and changes, ensuring operational readiness across systems, processes, documentation, controls, and downstream impacts.

  • Lead operational testing and validation efforts for your product, including functional testing, endtoend scenario testing, and quality checks.

  • Own and maintain productspecific operating procedures, ensuring documentation is accurate, current, and consistently followed.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, tooling improvements, and process efficiencies, partnering with your manager and crossfunctional teams to drive execution.

  • Build and execute operational monitoring and audit routines, including controls, reconciliations, exception tracking, and issue remediation.

  • Act as a subject matter expert for your product’s operations, supporting issue resolution, rootcause analysis, and escalations as needed.

  • Provide clear updates and insights to leadership on readiness status, risks, defects, and outcomes related to product changes.

lists.text: You Thrive Here By Possessing the Following:
lists.content:
• Bachelor’s degree in a related field or the equivalent through a combination of education and related work experience.

  • 3+ years of related experience in banking, financial services, operations, or lending.

  • Strong experience in financial services, fintech, or regulated operational environments.

  • Solid understanding of product operations lifecycles, including implementation, change management, testing, and ongoing support.

  • Proven ability to execute complex changes, manage dependencies, and work across multiple teams.

  • Experience with operational testing, audit support, controls, or quality assurance.

  • Strong analytical and problemsolving skills, with attention to detail and ownership mindset.

  • Ability to document processes clearly and think endtoend across systems and functions.

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and balancing multiple priorities.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executiveready updates.

  • Proficiency using data and operational insights to identify issues and improvements.

  • Direct experience supporting bankingasaservice, fintech, consumer lending, payment, or prepaid card products.

  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance considerations tied to financial products.

  • Experience in working with technology or product teams on changes

  • Exposure to automation, workflow tools, or operational platforms

  • Experience supporting product launches, pilots, or major enhancements

  • Comfort operating as a dedicated product owner within an operations organization.

  • Proficiency in SQL or PBI
